Billing.title: Billing & subscription
Billing.description: Choose the ContractFlow plan that fits your business. Subscription checkout and payment information are handled securely by Stripe.
Billing.checkoutSuccessDescription: Stripe is processing your subscription. Your billing status will update automatically.
Billing.checkoutCancelledDescription: No subscription change was made. You can choose a plan whenever you are ready.
Billing.currentSubscriptionDescription: Billing status for your active ContractFlow organization.
Billing.noSubscriptionDescription: Select a plan below to start your ContractFlow subscription.
Billing.scheduledCancellation: This subscription is scheduled to cancel on {date}.
Billing.choosePlanDescription: Select monthly or annual billing. The exact configured price will be shown in Stripe Checkout before payment.
Billing.manageExistingSuffix: to change or manage your existing Stripe subscription.
Billing.paymentSecurity: Subscription payment details are collected by Stripe. ContractFlow does not store your full card number.
Billing.starterDescription: Essential tools for small contractors getting organized.
Billing.proDescription: A stronger operating system for growing contracting businesses.
Billing.businessDescription: Built for larger teams managing higher job volume.
